If there's paperwork or an ACH/credit hold you need from our side, let me know and I'll loop procurement.

Hi Emma — great to hear the demo went well.

We can support a short-term top-up to avoid disruption. I can provision a $2,000 credit that will be valid for 7 calendar days from activation so your tests don't get interrupted. A couple of notes:

- This is a one-off bridging credit tied to Deal P-4921 and the attached PO.
- Credits over $1,500 require a quick approval from our revenue operations (I'm looping Kimberly).
- We ask that the PO or signed order be returned within 10 business days; otherwise we'll pause new provisioning.

If you confirm you'd like us to activate, I'll escalate internally for the short approval and turn the credit on same day. If procurement can provide a firm signature ETA or a soft commitment in writing (procurement@petra.ai), that helps speed us along.

I've also attached your trial usage snapshot to show expected burn.

Attachment: trial-usage-report.csv (CSV)

Cheers,
